market_view: NVDA-earnings week opens risk-off. At 6:40 ET futures are lower with tech leading (SPY 751.78 -0.3%, QQQ 674.10 -0.9%, IWM 276.59 -0.3%), NVDA is 158.86 pre-market (-2.5%) after a 13% drop last week when CEO Jensen Huang resigned, and TSM -4.2%, AMD -4.5%. The 10-year yield is 5.15%, the VIX 20, WTI US$88.30, gold US$3,878 (on its 20-day low). Bitcoin broke US$65,000 over the weekend (US$64,600) and crypto Fear & Greed is 10. Last week's C$200 bonus (2026-W46) was forfeited by the owner: no winner, nothing carried over. Saturday's review is live: Vega risks about 20% a trade with 2 positions, Kai keeps 16% cash and adds on fear once a week, Dax trades a quarter smaller, Fox's stops are tighter.
